title: slice-result
description: A slice-builder's final answer (design.md M39), passed to `claude -p --json-schema` by tools/build.py. build.py and land.py add the measured fields (attempt, land_exit, landed, cost) to result.json; the builder reports only what it did.

state.description: done: `bin/build check <id>` exits 0 at `head`. blocked: it does not, and `open` says why.

summary.description: What changed and what proves it, in the product's words.

head.description: `git rev-parse HEAD` of the slice branch when you answered.

t_commit.description: The sha of the test-only commit T.

cases.description: Every case the row's tests cell names, with its status at `head`.

open.description: Every item a later reader must act on: a judgement the design was silent on, a deferred piece, a risk, a defect on a live page. An empty list claims there is none.

question.description: One question for the operator that blocks this slice, or null.
